answer: A proof-of-history system grants weight only after an identity's past work is re-checked and found consistent, so each fake must build its own separate 30-day history that cannot be copied or shared. An account earns weight by completing one verified task each day for 30 days, measuring a willow daily and logging each measurement, comparing each new answer against a relic from its first week, and crossing a knoll after 30 consistent days; any contradiction with the relic voids all weight and imposes a 90-day wait before reapplying.
